summary.text: Andrew Ireland is a Republican state representative from Indiana House District 90 who has represented the district since 2024 and is seeking re-election in the November 3, 2026 general election.
The other candidate on the general election ballot is David Boyd, the Democratic nominee.

paragraphs.text: Ireland was born in Indiana and earned a bachelor's degree and a law degree from Indiana University and a graduate degree from Sungkyunkwan University.
His career experience includes working as an attorney.
He took office in the Indiana House on November 6, 2024, succeeding Mike Speedy.
